summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for git-snapshot.sh's silent-exit defect. Phase 1 adds RED-first fixture cases (held .git/index.lock, large-stash-list SIGPIPE, unlocked negative control); Phases 2-3 guard all four unguarded command substitutions and structurally replace both `git stash list | head -1 | cut` pipelines (including default mode's duplicate, which aborts after the tree is already reverted); Phase 4 documents the per-mode failure posture; Phase 5 redeploys and runs the full gate set. One research inconsistency was resolved at plan time and recorded in issues.jsonl.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan guarding all four unguarded command substitutions in git-snapshot.sh, structurally removing both SIGPIPE-prone stash-list pipelines, with RED-first fixture coverage and a redeploy/full-gate close.
